name: altoroj-challenge-account-balance
description: Sign in to the Altoro Mutual challenge using synthetic username {{username}} and password {{password}}, inspect account {{accountId}} inside the legacy account console, visually read the canvas-rendered Available balance, and return the numeric value as extracted output named balance.

steps.description: The landing page shows a Sign In link, which is the next step to reach the authentication form.

control.nearbyText: Sign In | Contact Us | Feedback | Search
control.robustnessRationale: Unique visible semantic link text identifies the sign-in navigation.

steps.description: The username field is empty and must be completed before authentication can proceed.

control.label: Username
control.robustnessRationale: This is the first empty credential textbox in the login form, identified by its adjacent Username label.

steps.description: Username is already populated and the password field is the next unmet sign-in condition.

control.label: Password
control.robustnessRationale: The password textbox is empty and identified by its nearby Password label; the provided CSS is a controlled fallback.

steps.description: The login credentials are already populated, so submit the form to proceed to the account console.

control.robustnessRationale: The only button in the populated Online Banking Login form; use the provided controlled CSS fallback.

steps.description: Enter the requested synthetic account record in the nested legacy console.

control.robustnessRationale: The record textbox is anchored by its table label; its changing UUID suffix is deliberately ignored.

steps.description: Submit the requested record for inspection inside the legacy console.

control.robustnessRationale: The only button in the nested legacy account console is the inspect action for the selected account.

steps.description: Allow the nested legacy result document, including deliberately delayed states, to settle before classification.

knownOutcomes.description: The supplied AltoroJ account record is not a six-digit number.
No AltoroJ account matches the requested record.
The authenticated AltoroJ operator cannot view this account.
The AltoroJ session expired before account details could be read.
The delayed AltoroJ account service failed to load.
The AltoroJ verification requires a human operator in the same live session.
